name: Bizppurio Messaging
description: Bizppurio SMS/LMS and KakaoTalk alimtalk messaging plugin.

settings.title: Bizppurio Messaging Settings
settings.description: Manage Bizppurio integration credentials and sending options.

test_mode.label: Inspection Mode
test_mode.hint: In inspection mode, messages are sent to the Bizppurio inspection domain. Turn it off to send through the production domain.
test_mode.account_notice: We recommend using separate Bizppurio accounts for inspection and production.

settings.live_mode_warning_body: Inspection mode is off, so real SMS and alimtalk messages are sent to actual customers and sending fees are charged. Keep inspection mode on during inspection.

api.title: API Integration
api.description: Credentials shared by the sending system and the Kakao management system.

sending.title: Sending Options
sending.description: Sender information used for SMS and alimtalk delivery.

bizppurio_id.label: Bizppurio ID
bizppurio_id.hint: The Bizppurio account ID used for both sending and Kakao management.

password.label: Bizppurio Module Password
password.hint: Please enter the Bizppurio module password. (Bizppurio console > Module Integration Settings > Change Module Password)

connection_check.label: Connection Check
connection_check.hint: Click to instantly verify the saved ID and password. (Only reflects saved values)
connection_check.success: Authentication verified successfully. The ID and password are correct.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.hint: The API key is issued after you submit it together with your ID to Bizppurio customer support.

sender_number.label: Sender Number
sender_number.hint: The sender phone number used for SMS and alimtalk delivery.

sender_key.label: Alimtalk Sender Profile Key
sender_key.hint: The 40-character sender profile key used for alimtalk delivery and template lookup.

template_cache_minutes.label: Alimtalk content cache (minutes)
template_cache_minutes.hint: Reuses Kakao template content for this period. 0 = always latest (not recommended for high volume).
template_cache_minutes.clear_cache_hint: If you edited a template in Kakao, click to apply it immediately.
template_cache_minutes.clear_cache_success: Template content cache cleared. The latest content will apply from the next dispatch.

report.hint: Bizppurio can push each SMS/alimtalk delivery result (success/failure) to this address (URL PUSH). Register it with the Bizppurio business team (or the report settings in the console).
report.note: Once registered, delivery results are recorded in the history so you can verify actual delivery. Before registration only the send request is confirmed; the final result (success/failure) is not updated.

cache.section_description: When sending alimtalk, the template content (body and buttons) registered in Kakao must be sent as-is. To avoid requesting the content from Kakao on every dispatch, the fetched content is reused (cached) for a set period. This keeps sending fast and avoids hitting Kakao's lookup rate limit even under high volume.

preparation.intro: To send SMS or Kakao Alimtalk messages, first complete the preparations below in the Bizppurio console.
preparation.kakao_channel: Create a KakaoTalk business channel and register a sender profile.
preparation.kakao_template: Register your Alimtalk templates and get them approved.
preparation.kakao_apikey: Request an API key from Bizppurio support.

binding.list_guide: Link a KakaoTalk alimtalk template to each notification. Use [Connect] to assign an approved template — the alimtalk message is then sent automatically when that event occurs.
binding.section_hint: Only approved alimtalk templates can be linked. Saving applies to this notification immediately.
binding.no_approved_templates: No approved (sendable) alimtalk templates. Register and inspect a template first.
binding.templates_load_failed: Failed to load the template list. Check the plugin settings (credentials).
binding.fallback_sms: Fall back to SMS on failure
binding.fallback_hint: If the alimtalk message fails, this notification's body is sent as an SMS instead.

banner.not_ready: Setup required for delivery is incomplete.
banner.test_mode: Inspection mode — messages are not actually sent.

dispatch_result.sent_content_hint: Alimtalk messages are sent using the actual content of the approved Kakao template, which may differ from the "Body" above.

templates.title: Alimtalk Templates
templates.description: Register, inspect, and manage KakaoTalk alimtalk templates. Only approved templates can be used for notification bindings.

readiness.title: The following settings are required to use alimtalk templates
readiness.note: Enter the items above on the Settings tab to browse and register templates. Actual delivery requires turning off inspection mode and using templates approved by Kakao.

list_error.title: Failed to load the template list

list_notice.console_desc: Register, edit, and review templates in the Bizppurio console.

list.empty_hint: Templates registered in the Bizppurio console appear here.
list.load_failed: Failed to load templates. Check the sender profile key and API key.

status_guide.title: Status badges
status_guide.sendable: Approved. Only this status can be linked to notifications and sent.
status_guide.inspecting: Kakao review in progress (2-3 business days).
status_guide.pending: Cannot be sent yet. Request review or edit in the console.
